cat > autoplay.py <<'PY'
import arena,subprocess,sys,chess,time
for i in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b): arena.show(b);break
 bans=[]
 for m in list(b.legal_moves):
  b.push(m)
  if b.is_repetition(2): bans.append(m.uci())
  b.pop()
 out=subprocess.check_output(['./think',b.fen(),sys.argv[2],','.join(bans)],text=True)
 open('analysis.log','a').write(b.fen()+'\n'+out+'\n')
 last=out.strip().splitlines()[-1];print(last,flush=True)
 m=last.split()[1]
 if m not in [x.uci() for x in b.legal_moves]:print('Invalid engine move');break
 print(str(b.fullmove_number)+'. '+b.san(chess.Move.from_uci(m)),flush=True)
 b=arena._request('move '+m)
 print('Black:',b.peek(),'; FEN:',b.fen(),flush=True)
 if arena.result(b): arena.show(b);break
else: arena.show(b)
